title: SHUTEN-DOJI
subtitle: the demon king whose head bit back
source: Otogi-zoshi 'Shuten-doji'; Heike monogatari Tsurugi no maki (Watanabe no Tsuna and Ibaraki-doji); Dojigiri Yasutsuna, Tokyo National Museum

lines.say: [excited] Kon! This sword cut off a DEMON'S head?!
[sly] It did. And then the head bit back.
[shocked] BIT BACK?!
[ominous] A thousand years ago, people were vanishing from Kyoto. Dragged off in the night by oni.
Their king was Shuten-doji. A giant red demon who drank sake by the barrel... and ate people.
cap: A giant red demon who drank

lines.say: [intense] So the emperor sent the deadliest warrior alive. Minamoto no Raiko. And his four elite guards.
[commanding] We climb that mountain tonight. And we don't come down without his head.
On the way, three old men gave them a gift. Sake. Harmless to humans. Poison to demons.
cap: On the way, three old men

lines.say: [annoyed] Sake AGAIN?! Japan's whole strategy is getting monsters drunk!
[amused] And it works every time. Disguised as monks, they walked straight into the demon fortress.
[booming] Holy men! Sit! Drink with us!
[whispering] The demons drank. Their arms went heavy. Their eyes went dim. Then Raiko threw off his robe. Armor.
cap: Then Raikō threw off his robe.

lines.say: [roaring] NOW!
[excited] Swords out. The five of them tore through the fortress. Room by room. Demon by demon.
cap: The five of them {r:tore through} the fortress.

lines.say: [intense] Shuten-doji roared, and his true form burst through the roof. Horns like spears. Eyes like fire.
cap: and his {r:true form} burst through the roof.

lines.say: [screaming] HE'S HUGE!
But the poison had his legs. Raiko leapt... and took his head off. One swing.
[darkly] The head didn't fall. It flew. Straight at Raiko... and sank its teeth into his helmet.
cap: and sank its {r:teeth} into his helmet.

lines.say: [screaming] THE HEAD BIT HIM?!
[smug] He lived. Because he'd stacked his men's helmets on top of his own.
cap: Because he'd stacked his men's helmets

lines.say: That sword is real. Dojigiri. The Demon Cutter. A National Treasure, in Tokyo, right now.
[sly] But one demon escaped. Ibaraki-doji. Later, one of the guards sliced off its arm, and locked it in a box.
cap: Later, one of the guards sliced off its {r:arm},

lines.say: [ominous] A few nights later, his old aunt came to visit. She asked to see the arm. He opened the box...
cap: She asked to see the arm.

lines.say: [sweetly] Oh, thank you, dear... [growling] THAT'S MINE!
[nervous] ...My aunt is visiting tomorrow.
[sly] Then don't show her anything in a box.
